text:
alex_sre: SLO burn alert in us-east1 — gateway 5xx spike + timeouts. Alert name: gateway.api.5xx_rate_slo_burn. Seeing ~12% error rate over last 5m. Paging the oncall.
maya_obs: @alex_sre ok can you drop the dashboard and a sample log query? :eyes:
alex_sre: datadog graph: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/xxxxxxxx/gateway-5xx (shared)
alex_sre: Quick log query I ran:
```
source:prod-gateway status:[500 TO 599] | json | stats count() by upstream_service, status
```
Result: most 5xx attributed to `billing-authorizer` and `auth-cache` upstreams. p95 latency for billing-authorizer ~2.8s (normally ~120ms).
jordan_oncall: any deploys in last hour? pagerduty: deploy-bot reported a config rollout at 1834520000 for `gateway-envoy` (no code change, envoy config tweak).
lee_runtime: I saw a small change last night to billing-authorizer deploy: mem/tuning params bumped (ticket INF-4321). Not a code change though.
sam_support: Support ticket thread: multiple customers see `502` and errors referencing "billing lookup failed" — they also saw billing UI errors. Might be related.
maya_obs: Traces are sparse — I think sampling in us-east1 is low (1%). Increasing for a minute to get full traces. Also our tracing agent shows many dropped spans due to timeouts to tracer collector.
alex_sre: Repro steps I ran:
1) curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (with a test key)
2) saw gateway 502 with upstream error: `upstream connect error or disconnect` and `context deadline exceeded`

lee_runtime: Checked billing-authorizer hosts: CPU ~95% on a node, DB latency high. Running `ps aux | grep nightly_backup` shows a long-running pg_dump process started ~40m ago. Looks like an overlapping backup job.
alex_sre: Query to find bad DB queries:
```
SELECT pid, age(now(), query_start), state, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE datname='billing' AND state!='idle'
ORDER BY query_start;
```
We saw a stuck VACUUM/pg_dump hogging locks.
jordan_oncall: Do we want to restart billing-authorizer now or kill the backup job? Prefer to avoid full restart until we confirm.
lee_runtime: I'm going to cancel the backup job on the DB host and restart the billing-authorizer pod with a rolling restart (scale=0/1). I'll do a quick restart of one instance to relieve load.
sam_support: FYI support escalated to an enterprise customer — they asked if this was billing-related. I'll keep them posted.
(2m later)
lee_runtime: killed pg_dump, then rolled billing-authorizer pod: `kubectl -n services rollout restart deployment/billing-authorizer` — CPU & latency dropping.
maya_obs: Dashboard shows 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 1.3% over last 5m. p95 latency for billing-authorizer back to ~130ms.
alex_sre: Traces are coming back, full spans show the call chain: gateway -> billing-authorizer -> postgres (blocked on backup). Good to confirm root cause.
jordan_oncall: Marking incident as mitigated. Logging postmortem item.
alex_sre: Action items agreed:
- Add circuit breaker + short TTL cache in gateway for billing-authorizer lookups (lee_runtime)
- Add DB backup job guard to prevent overlapping backups (infra)
- Increase trace sampling temporarily on SLO burns and add an alert when spans dropped > 10% (maya_obs)
- Add runbook step for killing blocking DB jobs + safe restart of billing-authorizer (jordan_oncall)
sam_support: I'll send a customer-facing note saying root cause was transient DB backup causing billing lookups to time out; mention we mitigated and are working on safeguards.
maya_obs: Also let's tune the alert to include "top upstream by 5xx" to avoid noisy pages for unrelated spikes.
alex_sre: Thanks all. Keeping this thread for postmortem notes and links to dashboards + logs. Closing page in 1h unless new anomalies.
deploy-bot: (deploy job summary) rollout restart done for billing-authorizer at 1834567920
pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by jordan_oncall
